user.title: Connect a Daikin EKMBDXB7V1
user.description: The adapter uses Modbus RTU over RS485. Choose a serial port, or connect through a Modbus TCP gateway.

tcp.title: Modbus TCP
tcp.description: Connect through a gateway that converts Modbus TCP to the adapter’s serial RTU connection.

data_description.host: The gateway’s hostname or IP address.
data_description.port: The gateway’s Modbus TCP port, usually 502.
data_description.unit_id: The adapter’s address, set by DIP switches (1–15).

serial.title: Serial port (Modbus RTU)
serial.description: Select the port connected to the adapter’s RS485 terminals. Match the baud rate and parity to its DIP switches.

data_description.device: Select a local serial port or a port shared over the network by a serial proxy.
data_description.parity: Match the DIP switches: even/odd parity uses one stop bit; no parity supports one or two.
data_description.unit_id: The adapter’s address, set by DIP switches (1–15).

error.cannot_connect: Could not read a ready EKMBDXB7V1 and at least one communicating climate unit. Check the connection, Modbus address and DIII-Net wiring.
error.connection_conflict: This connection is already in use with different settings.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address.
